summary_en: 1,937,500 shares acquired at ¥1,340/share via tender offer (30 business days, 9 Jul–21 Aug 2026). Minimum acceptance threshold of 1,291,700 shares met; all tendered securities purchased. Settlement 28 Aug 2026. Target to become Arealink consolidated subsidiary. Warrants also acquired (550,000 yen per 1st warrant; 350,000 yen per 2nd warrant).
title_en: Notice of Results of Tender Offer for Shares of Storage-O Co., Ltd. (Securities Code: 2997) and Changes in Subsidiary Status
translation_en_brief: Arealink Co., Ltd. (Ticker 8914, Tokyo Standard Market) announced on 22 August 2026 the successful completion of its tender offer for Storage-O Co., Ltd. (Code 2997, TSE Growth Market). The offer ran for 30 business days from 9 July to 21 August 2026 and targeted 1,937,500 common shares at ¥1,340 per share, with a minimum acceptance threshold of 1,291,700 shares. The threshold was met; all tendered securities were purchased. The tender offer also covered two series of warrants: 1st-series warrants at ¥550,000 each and 2nd-series warrants at ¥350,000 each. Settlement is scheduled for 28 August 2026, upon which Storage-O will become a consolidated subsidiary of Arealink. The filing states that this acquisition of all issued shares (and warrants) was undertaken with the principal objective of making the target a wholly owned subsidiary.
